description: CNA::Diagnostics: a bounded recording reports what it dropped, resources follow their handles, and the instrumentation macros do what the compile-time level promises
expectRegex: \[museum\]\[diagnostics\] overflow: StartRecording\(16\) kept [0-9]+ events and reports [1-9][0-9]* dropped
pl-diagnostics CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_GAUGE_SET 40 then GAUGE_ADD 2 at level [0-2]: PASS
pl-diagnostics CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_FRAME_COUNTER_ADD registers a per-frame counter at level [0-2]: PASS
pl-diagnostics CNA_PROFILE_SCOPE\("Museum/MacroScope"\) in the trace at level [0-2]: PASS
pl-diagnostics CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_EVENT\("Museum/MacroEvent"\) in the trace at level [0-2]: PASS
expect: [museum][diagnostics] re-registration: after Reset the resource is gone; registered again it is listed
